title: Hold a water bore driller's licence
what: Carry out water bore drilling only as a licensed water bore driller or under one's constant supervision.

sources.title: Water Act 2000 (Qld)
sources.quote: An individual must not carry out a water bore drilling activity, other than an exempt activity, unless the individual is— (a) licensed under chapter 8 , part 2B to carry out the activity; or (b) under the constant physical supervision of an individual who is licensed under chapter 8 , part 2B to carry out the activity;
